blocks.text: I never know if it sent. There's no clear sign an inspection actually made it. (Inspector, Michigan)
Same as above. I end up opening it twice to check. (Site lead, Ohio)
Please add a dark mode. The screen is very bright in the yard at 5 am. (Inspector, Minnesota)
Can the signed report show the site name and not just the site code? Our auditors don't know the codes. (Warehouse manager, Utah)
Would like to add a note to a photo. (Inspector, Tennessee)
The offline badge at the top is helpful. (Inspector, Kentucky)
No issues so far. Used it all week. (Site lead, Missouri)
Install was easy. Login took two tries. (Inspector, Colorado)
Excited to try offline mode, our back lot has no signal. (Inspector, Idaho)
That's all the feedback so far. Thanks for testing.
